title: Perfect day trip
text: Peter and Carl were great! The tour was entertaining and well planned. I especially liked the “Name that tune karaoke”. It was a perfect day.
author: G6101WBkarim

title: first private tour
text: The brothers were very great to travel with. Their local info and history were very interesting. One of the most enjoyable tours we've ever taken. We will certainly consider future private tours after this experience. Having 2 guides definitely facilitated being able to stop and visit sites
author: J4996XCkenm

title: Fantastic - strongly recommend
text:
What a fantastic day out with Carl and Peter. Hotel pick up was perfect, the van was air conditioned and everything exactly as advertised.  The brothers were entertaining and we felt we had a real conversation with them about Andorra and the whole countryside either side of the route. The driving was safe and calm. We had loads of stops on the way and in Andorra, several interesting stops and good picks for meals and coffee. The combination of moving the van while we walked a bit was clever and saved no end of time. 

A thoroughly well designed tour delivered by two real friendly people-person
author: T4363PGjonathanc

title: Andorra insites
text: Peter and Carl made a wonderful team. Excellent information about the sites we visited, and enjoyed some special side stops with great views. Was really nice to be dropped off with one of the guides, while the other drove to a pick-up place so we didn't have to drive around looking for parking.  Also great insite into geopolitical Andorra.
author: jz37

title: So much to see! Beautiful!
text: The visit to the town of Mont Louis was a perfect taste of French Country. Andorra was charming. The Pyrenees were beautiful all day long. Our guide..... THE BEST!
author: Deborah G

title: What a day!! Peter and...
text: What a day!! Peter and Carl were exceptional guides. They are very knowledgeable about the history of Andorra, Spain, and France and made sure that we had time at several locations for pictures, shopping, and sight seeing. It is a bit of a road trip day, but the views are spectacular, laughs and good conversation were had, and the ride back to Barcelona is the perfect time for a nap with comfy blankets and pillows in the van. Highly recommend this experience for anyone looking to see the Pyrenees and Catalonia countryside with two lovely gentlemen leading the way!
author: Kelsey_H

title: A truly remarkable day!
text:
I cannot say enough about what wonderful guides Carl and Peter are. They are not only extremely knowledgeable, but are also so engaging that even a tour that involves an 11 hour day seems to just fly by. They had a well-organized plan with enough flexibility to make the most of the time available.

Andorra is so beautiful and we were really happy to have an opportunity to learn about their its interesting history and what things are like there today. It was a great opportunity to visit a little known place.

author: Torfamm

title: Best Tour To Be Found
text: This was the best tour that we've ever been on! Peter and Carl are great. They picked us up at the hotel and showed us a fabulous day of Spain, France, and Caledonia. They even tried the're hardest to find my wife a Dr Pepper soda, but there was none to be found. They really know the history of this area and kept us informed. They went over and above to make this tour great. They are highly recommend!
author: kylerA1228JG

title: Day Trip from Barcelona
text: This excursion was well worth the money. We were picked up at the hotel and began our excursion starting in Barcelona. We stopped for breakfast which was fantastic. We then travelled on to see beautiful places, lots of history, and made various stops throughout the day. Carl and Peter were excellent hosts. They both went on for hours about the different countries and scenic sights we visited that day. Stopped for lunch at a quaint little restaurant they served delicious food.
